description: This file defines a mock class 'OcdmMock' for testing purposes, which inherits from the 'IOcdm' interface. It includes a mocked method 'isTypeSupported' to simulate checking if a media key type is supported, used in unit tests within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: OcdmMock
classes.description: A mock class for the IOcdm interface used in testing, providing a mocked method 'isTypeSupported'.

methods.name: isTypeSupported
methods.description: A mocked method that simulates checking if a given key system type is supported, returning a MediaKeyErrorStatus.
